title: 1RB0RC_1LC1RE_1RA1LD_0LC0LA_1RF1RD_---0RD: the run as a map of one number, no halt in 6.5·10<sup>32</sup> steps
text: From one zigzag start to the next the run is one affine map away from the halting rows (13 cases, proved in Lean for all sizes): in x = a/(a + r) it is x → 4x/3 or 4x − 3, and a halt needs x to land on 3/4 to the cell. Lean checks 10<sup>8</sup> passes (3.9·10<sup>15</sup> frames); C ran 1.8·10<sup>11</sup> passes. The revised heuristic puts the median halt near 10<sup>14</sup> passes, 10<sup>41</sup> steps.
